verbs.name: context
verbs.summary: what binds this perimeter and what is claimable; with a claim held, the criterion and the constraints in full
notes: a constraint is never truncated in execution mode; a cut is always announced

verbs.name: claim
verbs.summary: takes the task and freezes its done_criteria by hash; refuses one held, blocked, or finished on another branch
notes: --criteria sets a criterion the task does not have, and records it as the claimer's; it never replaces one

refuses.when: the task is held by another agent, or finished on another branch
the task is blocked, or has no done_criteria to freeze

verbs.name: show
verbs.summary: the entity whole, frontmatter and body, byte for byte

refuses.when: no such entity, or the prefix matches more than one

verbs.name: log
verbs.summary: an id alone reads the log; an id and a message appends one and renews the claim, which needs holding it

refuses.when: writing with no claim held by this agent

verbs.name: done
verbs.summary: runs the verifiers the task's verify: list names, records what ran, and moves the task to done; needs the claim, and a proof when that list is empty
notes: --proof is <type>:<ref>; type is commit, human-review, assertion or test
config.yml defines the verifiers; the task's verify: list decides which of them run

refuses.when: no proof, and the task's verify: list names no verifier to produce one
no claim held by this agent, or the frozen done_criteria has diverged

verbs.name: release
verbs.summary: hands the task back, with the reason recorded in its log

refuses.when: no claim held by this agent

verbs.name: new
verbs.summary: writes a task, an ADR or a spec that needs no hand finishing
notes: a scope is mandatory: an entity attached to nothing is invisible
--body - reads the body from stdin, so a long one needs no shell quoting
--reference declares what a spec rests on; it takes a spec or an adr, and check resolves it

refuses.when: no --title or --scope and $EDITOR is unset, so there is nothing to open

verbs.name: find
verbs.summary: searches titles, scopes and criteria; --type spec reaches the specification, --status open lists what remains
notes: --status filters on the stored status; a claimed row still displays as [claimed:who]
a listing counts the open rows a claim would refuse, and names --free
--free keeps the open tasks no live claim's scope overlaps, and says how many it hid

verbs.name: status
verbs.summary: where am I: branch, claim, perimeter, queue, findings
notes: --remote reads the claim refs from origin with ls-remote and never fetches; without it status describes the local plane only

verbs.name: review
verbs.summary: the ratification queue and the health of the corpus: what is proposed, and which scopes have gone dead
notes: exit 8 means findings, as it does for check; a signal alone leaves it 0

verbs.name: accept
verbs.summary: promotes a proposed ADR or spec to accepted, through a signed ratification commit; on the default branch only
notes: the one act ank commits for; it is a human act, signed

refuses.when: no such entity, or the prefix matches more than one
not on the default branch, and there is no way around it
the default branch cannot be determined, from config.yml or from origin

verbs.name: close
verbs.summary: closes a task that will never be done; --reason is mandatory

refuses.when: no --reason: a closure nobody explained is one nobody can reopen
no such entity, or the prefix matches more than one

verbs.name: amend
verbs.summary: changes blocked_by, references, scope, and a done_criteria no live claim freezes
notes: adds and removes explicitly, never a replacement list, so nothing is dropped by being forgotten
--criteria replaces the criterion outright, and leaves criteria_by where it stands
--reference and --drop-reference reach a spec's citations, on an accepted one too: the anchor covers its body and scope, not what it cites

refuses.when: --criteria while a live claim freezes the criterion; that case is a release

verbs.name: attest
verbs.summary: appends a proof to a finished task: the one write allowed after done
notes: --proof is <type>:<ref>; type is commit, human-review, assertion or test
--detached records the proof in refs/ank/proof/<id> and writes no file, so a pipeline anchors a run without a commit

refuses.when: no such entity, or the prefix matches more than one
--detached and the remote unreachable: the ref is the whole product, and a proof no other clone can read is no proof

verbs.name: edit
verbs.summary: opens an entity in $EDITOR and validates what comes back
notes: $EDITOR is a command line run through sh, not a program name
a GUI editor needs its wait flag, or it returns before you have typed and the file is written back unedited

refuses.when: $EDITOR is unset, and there is no editor to open

verbs.name: graph
verbs.summary: the blocked_by DAG in readable text, indented under what blocks it

verbs.name: scope
verbs.summary: what covers a path: the constraints that bind it, the specifications that govern it, and the tasks that touch it

verbs.name: check
verbs.summary: the mechanical invariants: parse, round-trip, references, frozen fields, orphaned claims; prunes the claim refs it finds stale, so it writes
notes: exit 8 means findings; a signal alone leaves it 0
the only verb that prunes refs/ank/claims: orphans, and completion refs whose task is done or closed on the default branch

verbs.name: migrate
verbs.summary: rewrites the previous log directory as entries, one entity per entry, and removes what it read
notes: the entry count is asserted equal before and after, and every message is read back and compared
it writes files and never commits: review with git status .ank

refuses.when: a log file the grammar refuses, or one whose entity is not in the corpus: named, and nothing is written

verbs.name: config
verbs.summary: reads and writes .ank/config.yml: the key alone reads, a value writes, --unset removes
notes: keys: schema context_budget claim_ttl_max claim_ttl_default default_branch peers.<name> verifiers.<name>.run verifiers.<name>.timeout
a resolved default prints marked as one; --json carries value and source as separate fields
--unset verifiers.<name> removes a whole verifier, which is what makes declaring one reversible

refuses.when: a key the parser does not know, or a value in a form the surgery cannot edit safely
verifiers.<name>.timeout on a verifier that is not declared

verbs.name: init
verbs.summary: creates .ank/ here or at <path>, writes config.yml, adds the refs/ank/* refspec; refuses --repo
notes: a target elsewhere is ank init <path>; with no argument it initialises the current directory

refuses.when: --repo: it names a repository that exists, and this verb makes one; the target is positional

verbs.name: help
verbs.summary: every verb grouped by the moment it is used, or one verb in full

refuses.when: no such verb; never a fallback to the general listing
